security_spec.violation_condition: When QEMU TCG executes a CSR read-write instruction targeting the seed CSR (address 0x015) from S/HS or U mode without first checking that the corresponding mseccfg.SSEED (bit 9) or mseccfg.USEED (bit 8) is set to 1, or when QEMU fails to raise a virtual-instruction exception (rather than illegal-instruction) for seed CSR read-write access from VS/VU modes when mseccfg.SSEED=1 and the H extension is implemented.
security_spec.summary: QEMU TCG must enforce mseccfg.SSEED/USEED access-control bits for the seed CSR on every access from S/HS/U/VS/VU modes; missing checks leak guest-visible entropy to unprivileged modes, and failure to raise virtual-instruction (vs. illegal-instruction) for VS/VU seed accesses breaks hypervisor trap-and-emulate of the entropy source.
